# dokploy_redis (Data Source)

Look up a Dokploy redis service by id, or by name within an environment. The data source does not expose the database password. It exposes each other credential attribute as sensitive.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dokploy_redis" "example" {
  id = "your-redis-id"
}

# By name, within an environment.
data "dokploy_redis" "by_name" {
  environment_id = data.dokploy_environment.production.id
  name           = "cache"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `environment_id` (String) Id of the environment to search. Required with `name`.
- `id` (String) Redis service id. Set this attribute, or set both `environment_id` and `name`.
- `name` (String) Exact redis service name. The lookup searches within `environment_id` and errors when zero or many redis services match.

### Read-Only

- `app_name` (String) Internal Dokploy app name.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `docker_image` (String) Docker image.
- `external_port` (Number) Exposed host port, if any.
- `status` (String) Service status.
